info.title: Corpotex API
info.description: Supplier and workshop management with a WhatsApp agent.

get.description:
Open alerts. `?mine=1` keeps only the ones that concern the caller's role, with the same
rule the assistant uses to notify (ADR 0020). `?status=` filters; default `open`.

post.description:
Does not revoke the token: in the demo the same user has two windows open, and a
revocation would log the other one out. The client just forgets the token.

get.description:
Read-only chat for the simulator and the purchase order detail (manager only: supplier
messages may carry prices).
`GET /api/dispatches/?status=ready,delivered&from=&to=&vehicle_ids=&unassigned=1`.

post.description: Idempotent: the same action again returns 200 with the current state; a different one, 409.

get.description:
`GET /api/materials/`: every material ordered by kind and name; `?kind=`, `?q=` (sku or name). `committed` is the sum of
`Requirement.qty_from_stock` of open orders; `available = stock - committed`; `to_order` is what is still to buy
(as in "Por pedir") and `incoming` the live purchase orders that will bring it.
`GET /api/materials/<id>/`: the list row plus the open orders that take from it.
Counters for the menu and the assistant button, polled every 5 s (ADR 0020, 0022).

Everything the Monitor page shows, in one call. Shape agreed with `disenador`
(frontend/mocks/monitor.json); manager-only parts are `null` for the other roles.

get.description:
The workshop's public page (`/report/<token>`): no login, the token is the secret.
Never prices nor the supplier (ADR 0024 C).

get.description:
`GET /api/requirements/pending/`: open material requirements grouped by material, the
"Por pedir" screen (ADR 0025 A). Manager and production; prices only for the manager.

`GET /api/routes/`: all routes (`?date=`, `?status=a,b`; `?fleet=1` only the vehicles'
trips, `?vehicle_ids=1,2`), or with `?current=1` the pair `{current, replaced}` the map shows
(ADR 0024).
Any route in any status: the scene opens `before` and `after` side by side.

post.description: `POST /api/routes/<id>/complete/`: in_progress → completed.
`POST /api/routes/<id>/start/`: planned → in_progress.
`POST /api/routes/<id>/stops/<stop_id>/deliver/`: the order goes `delivered`.
`POST /api/routes/plan/ {date}` (manager and production): plans or re-plans that day.
`POST /api/routes/plan-day/ {date, vehicle_ids?, order_ids?}` (ADR 0026 §2).

get.description: `GET /api/vehicles/`: the active fleet with its last position.

`POST /api/vehicles/<id>/positions/` (manager, production and the simulator) moves the
vehicle and keeps one sample every `VEHICLE_SAMPLE_SECONDS`; `GET ?from=&to=` is the trail.

post.description:
`POST /api/vehicles/<id>/positions/` (manager, production and the simulator) moves the
vehicle and keeps one sample every `VEHICLE_SAMPLE_SECONDS`; `GET ?from=&to=` is the trail.

`POST /api/vehicles/<id>/simulate/ {speed_factor=12, interval_s=3}` starts the simulator on
the vehicle's route in progress; `DELETE` stops it.

delete.description:
`POST /api/vehicles/<id>/simulate/ {speed_factor=12, interval_s=3}` starts the simulator on
the vehicle's route in progress; `DELETE` stops it.

get.description: `GET /api/vehicles/live/?ids=1,2`: the current picture, for the polling fallback.

`GET /api/vehicles/stream/?ids=1,2`: server-sent events (ADR 0026 §4). The front reads it
with `fetch` (the token goes in a header, which `EventSource` cannot send).
